advisoryFindings.title: R3 assertion is slightly over-specific
advisoryFindings.improvement: Consider making the rejection test assert only the required non-zero exit and correction containing `sdd-forge flow get status`, unless the exact `unknown command 'status'` wording is an intentional contract.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: The current test still exercises production CLI behavior and covers R3; the extra wording assertion may just be tighter than the stated requirement.
